entry.author: Unitec
entry.summary:
Hear from Unitec School of Creative Industries alumni, Monique Bradley (Ngāti Rārua) as she shares her experience studying Unitec's Master of Creative Practice (MCP) programme.

Tailored to artists, designers, makers and creative professionals, the MCP programme supports students with the development of a body of creative work through practice-led research, with a dedicated supervision team and a community of fellow creatives.

Study the MCP full-time in 18 months (with part-time options also available).

Applications for July 2026 or February 2027 are open — enrol now to start mastering your craft.

https://www.unitec.ac.nz/career-and-study-options/creative-industries/master-of-creative-practice/
